Rheotens and Haul-Off
Product catalog summary
Overview: The document provides detailed information on the RHEOTENS and HAUL-OFF systems, focusing on elongational testing for polymer melts. It highlights the technical advancements and features of the RHEOTENS 71.97 model.
Specifications: The system includes a patented tandem pulley system with an additional pair of pull-off wheels for enhanced performance. The speed control is stepless and variable up to 1900 mm/s, with an acceleration of 3200 mm/s². The force measurement range is from 0 to 2 N with a resolution of 0.001 N, and calibration is automatic.
Software: The Windows® software is designed for user-friendliness, integrating evaluation functions into MS EXCEL® for easy data presentation and processing. A joystick allows for complete control of experiments.
New Functions: The system now includes exponential speed control in addition to linear constant pull-off speed and constant acceleration. The determination of the elongational viscosity function is integrated, based on Prof. Wagner's work.
Elongational Rheometer Features: The RHEOTENS 71.97 offers higher pull-off speeds, adjustable from 0-600 m/min or 0-2000 m/min (optional). It can differentiate polymer melts with small molecular structure differences not detectable by analytical methods.
Technical Diagrams: The document includes several figures explaining the technical aspects:
Figure 1: Shows the relationship between maximum draw-off speed and melt strength.
Figure 2: Introduces the 'Super-Master-Curve' for simplifying RHEOTENS curves based on extrusion history.
Figure 3: Describes the 'Grand-Master-Curve' for further integration, focusing solely on polymer characteristics.
Figure 4: Details the determination of effective elongational viscosity using an analytical model.
Contact Information: The document provides contact details for GÖTTFERT offices in Germany, USA, India, and China.
Conclusion: RHEOTENS curves are crucial for identifying subtle differences in polymer behavior, which are not detectable through shear experiments. The document emphasizes the importance of these tests in understanding molecular distribution differences in samples.

Elongational Rheometer for Polymer Melts

determined from shear experiments.
The patented RHEOTENS melt elongation testing technique has proven to be highly reproducible and sensitive and will
differentiate even polymer melts showing small differences in molecular structure which can not be detected with
analytical methods.
